versions.content: The shortName of the referenced container provides the symbolic name in the implementation The shortName of the referenced des- tination is expected to be the provided symbolic name in the implementation later on. Therefore the code generator of the providing module has the responsibility to associate the provided symbolic name 24 to its actual value.
